scope: ViMDoc label-free score cache on the A007 v2 pages: OCR (16 CPU shards), ColQwen2.5 and BGE-M3 query and passage encoding with GPU MaxSim and dense scores (16 L4 shards), BM25 via vidore_benchmark 5.0.0, candidate union (top-200 per channel, union <= 600) with per-query min-max normalization, and the dev-only coverage audit. The doc_ids column is read once and split into dev qrels and a sealed confirmation file that Stage 1 does not read.

approval.recorded_by: Claude at the Research Lead's request

label_rules: doc_ids is read only in prepare, split immediately; confirmation qrels are written once, hashed and not read in Stage 1.
Dev qrels are used only for the coverage report, after every candidate union is frozen.
No score, union, normalization or model choice depends on any label.
retry_rule: Each step and shard runs once. A step or shard whose _SUCCESS marker exists is skipped on a re-launch; a failed one is recorded, and any re-attempt needs a note in this record. Stop if projected spend passes the cap.
